protocol.singleIndependentVariable: When current deterministic admission abstains and RequestedAnswerSlot projects safely, allow an extractive QA model to propose one exact visible answer span, then require a separately pinned multilingual NLI classifier to entail a generic question-plus-answer hypothesis from the source sentence containing that span. QA score/decision and slot projection are not evidence authority. Existing deterministic supports remain unchanged.

nliHypothesisTemplates.EN: The answer to the question "<QUESTION>" is "<ANSWER>".
nliHypothesisTemplates.ES: La respuesta a la pregunta "<QUESTION>" es "<ANSWER>".

protocol.sourcePremise: Shortest source sentence containing the exact QA-proposed span.

developmentCalibration.entailmentThresholdCandidates: observed entailment scores plus fixed grid 0.50..0.99
developmentCalibration.thresholdSelection: Among boundaries satisfying every safety gate, select highest entailment threshold then highest margin; development only.

distinctionFromPriorRejects: #68 used manually generated positive/negative relation hypotheses plus role/direction guards; this cascade uses a QA-proposed exact source span and one generic Q+A hypothesis.
#69/#70 used extractive QA as support authority; here QA is span proposal only.
#71 used QA as a veto/intersection on deterministic support; this candidate only operates after deterministic abstention.
#90/#101 used the generative ReaderEvidenceVerifier; this candidate uses no generative reader or prompt.
